assumptions.statement: The submitted site and three key-area polygons are provisional rough geometries fitted to public textual extents and approximate announced areas.
assumptions.impact: All participant-controlled layers and geometry-derived metrics require full-package replacement and recomputation after official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Repository Issue #846 records a possible material mismatch between the submitted provisional site and an external mapped background, but does not provide sufficient evidence to move or replace the polygon.
assumptions.impact: The current geometry remains unchanged and non-statutory; official coordinate-bearing polygons trigger full replacement, recomputation, redraw and review.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, setbacks, road redlines, ownership, heritage control zones, utilities, fire access and flood constraints are unknown.
assumptions.impact: No statutory, parcel-level or engineering conclusion is made; building masses are conceptual carriers only.

assumptions.statement: Current buildings, footfall, vendor mix, food logistics, kitchen capacity, organic-material flows, accessibility and public-service baselines are not available as cleared survey data.
assumptions.impact: Food-system, public-space and circularity indicators remain test methods or design targets, not measured performance claims.

assumptions.statement: No university, food laboratory, enterprise, kitchen, market, vendor, public agency or community operator is presented as a confirmed project partner.
assumptions.impact: All collaboration interfaces require consent, qualifications, food-safety responsibility, data rights, role assignment and procurement review.

assumptions.statement: Public-facing AI scenarios do not create individual dietary profiles, diagnose allergies, certify food safety, automate regulatory decisions or require default personal tracking.
assumptions.impact: Any later food production, sale, personalised recommendation, safety assessment or personal-data use requires qualified human responsibility, applicable permissions and a separately approved workflow.

assumptions.statement: Global cases are used only to compare transferable mechanisms.
assumptions.impact: Their governance, land metrics, institutions and outcomes are not treated as Beijing evidence.

assumptions.statement: Events, pilots, service counters and operating roles are proposals for later agreement.
assumptions.impact: The package does not claim funding, implementation, endorsement or guaranteed outcomes.

assumptions.statement: Haidian industrial, research, open-source, embodied-AI and technology-transfer records describe district-level context and policy mechanisms, not resources committed to this proposal.
assumptions.impact: No university, laboratory, compute platform, robot, funding programme or technology-transfer service is presented as available without separate consent, qualification and agreement.

assumptions.statement: The asset steward, platform operator, licensed food operator, research evaluator and statutory or professional reviewers have not been appointed.
assumptions.impact: Facility cards, responsibility assignments and phase gates remain design requirements; no facility is counted as operational until responsibilities, permits and stop conditions close.

assumptions.statement: Accessibility moves require testing with older adults, disabled users, caregivers, workers and visitors.
assumptions.impact: Passing a technical check alone cannot authorize public release.

assumptions.statement: Beiwei Community, Future Science City, Huairou Science City, Beijing E-Town and Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei are proposed referral or exchange interfaces only; no institution, route, data feed, venue, funding or agreement is confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Regional synergy remains a staged interface design. Each external connection requires a named counterpart, consent, authority, data and rights terms, funding, service level and a tested handoff before use.

assumptions.statement: The first-90-day plan is an acceptance sequence, not authorization to open a public food, AI, market, logistics or material-circulation service.
assumptions.impact: No public operation may begin until the host, rights, permits, licensed operator, insurance, accessibility, human fallback, data handling, emergency response, qualified receivers and stop authority are documented and accepted.

assumptions.statement: Any low, medium or high cost band in the proposal is a relative option class, not a budget, estimate, quotation or funding commitment.
assumptions.impact: Capital, operating and unit-cost metrics remain unknown until a host site, measured scope, procurement route, quotations, operator model, permit path and contingency basis are confirmed.

assumptions.statement: The cover is an AI-assisted original conceptual image generated without a reference image; the exact backend or model identifier was not exposed.
assumptions.impact: It may be used only as a package cover under the proposal licence. It is not current-site, surveyed, architectural, engineering, approval, partnership or implementation evidence.
